name: WCCM Denmark
reason: Too thin and stale: wccm.dk lists no planned events ('Der er ingen planlagte arrangementer p.t.'), its latest news is from 2024-2025 and its online meditation page points to the international WCCM Zoom room; leaves only how-to and children's pages.
